1. Download a simple SVG icon from an icon library. SVG Repo and The SVG are good starting points.

2. Add a button and select exactly one keyboard key.

3. Import the normal SVG. By default it is recolored to pure black (#000000).

4. A pressed SVG is optional. If you do not provide one, the normal SVG is reused. By default the pressed icon is recolored to #E6E6E6 and shifted down slightly like a Minecraft button.

5. Keep Original Colors lets you preserve the SVG colors separately for normal and pressed states.

6. Icon Size and Icon X/Y Offset adjust the artwork inside the Minecraft-style button. Button Size changes the whole on-screen control.

7. Choose whether the keyboard mapping is momentary or toggle. Momentary holds the mapped key only while you hold the button; toggle alternates key down and key up on each tap.

More Buttons intentionally supports only one key per button and does not provide macros, key sequences, automatic repeats or autoclicking.
Exactly one keyboard key can be mapped to each custom button.
Off: hold the key only while the button is held. On: one tap presses the key and the next tap releases it.
Off: recolor the normal icon to pure black (#000000). On: preserve the SVG\'s original colors.
A separate pressed SVG is optional for both momentary and toggle buttons. Without one, the normal SVG is reused. Off recolors the pressed icon to #E6E6E6; On preserves the selected SVG colors.
The whole button can still be repositioned from the HUD Editor. Icon X/Y only moves the artwork inside the button in small 512px-canvas steps.

LBBL needs access to all files to install and run Minecraft correctly. Without this permission, the launcher may not be able to install versions or save game data.

Android 11+ uses the FUSE filesystem for public external storage, which adds overhead when writing many small files and makes importing large packs noticeably slower.

Default directory (app-specific Android/data) bypasses FUSE and imports fast, but its data is removed when the launcher is uninstalled.

Custom directory lives on public storage, so data survives uninstall, but importing large packs will be noticeably slower.

A naturally generated structure. Explore it to find its loot.
A settlement of villagers with houses and farms that vary by biome. Home to trading, iron golems and raids.
A sandstone pyramid in the desert. Beneath the floor of the central hall lies a trap guarding 4 loot chests.
A mossy stone ruin in the jungle. Solve the lever and piston puzzle to reach the loot chests.
The home of a witch, with a brewing cauldron inside. Witches spawn here.
A snow house on the plains. Half of igloos have a basement with a villager and a zombie villager — a lesson in curing.
The wreck of a sunken or beached ship in several forms. Cabins hold loot chests and sometimes treasure maps.
Underwater stone-brick ruins that differ between warm and cold oceans. Loot chests hide among the rubble.
A prismarine monument in the deep ocean, guarded by guardians and elder guardians. Gold blocks and sponge rooms lie within.
A huge mansion in the dark forest, home to vindicators and evokers — defeat an evoker to obtain a totem of undying.
A watchtower camp of pillagers. A loot chest sits on top; killing the banner captain triggers a raid.
The remains of a nether portal of obsidian and crying obsidian, with gold blocks and a chest — like an ancient accident.
A ruined city in the deep dark, where wardens lurk. Loot includes Swift Sneak books and echo shards.
A chest buried under beach sand, located with a treasure map from shipwrecks. It holds a heart of the sea.
A network of abandoned tunnels underground, with wooden supports and cobwebs. Minecart chests hold ores and food.
A buried settlement ruin. Brush suspicious gravel with a brush to reveal pottery sherds and decorations.
A maze of copper rooms with trial spawners that scale with player count. Complete trials for keys and treasure.
A dark brick fortress in the Nether, home to blazes and wither skeletons. Blaze spawners hide within.
A purpur city on the outer End islands, guarded by shulkers. Its treasures include elytra and dragon heads.
